token_policy: teacher-force the complete frozen trace; no generated suffix is compared across arms
write_intervention: zero the frozen targeted-bank pre-O head slices at the registered final retrieval query only
mediator_intervention: cumulatively clamp the clean carrier state from the model-specific source layer through the penultimate layer
matched_control: equal-token near-depth non-item clean states clamped at the same carrier positions and layers
primary_estimands: selected carrier deformation relative to clean
reduction in final-layer boundary-state distance after clean carrier restoration
clean-carrier restoration advantage over the matched-position state control
gate_policy: direction and magnitude of the three primary estimands are decisive; confidence intervals and p-values are retained as records
